# Welcome To Devilstation!
Rules exist to keep communities from turning into shitholes. Devilstation is small, so we expect you to, at the very least, acknowledge how much one person has an impact on the community. If you are ever wondering, "Does this follow the rules?" Then ask yourself a different question, "Will this bother another player?" If no, then it may serve to improve a round. Keep that in mind, as these rules are not insurmountable walls. They can, and will, bend as the community requires.
Metacommunications are entirely okay, so long as it does not interrupt the round flow. Teaching someone the game? Just chatting in a voice call while doing some mining? Go ahead! The OOC discussion channel is permanently open for a reason. We're not some crazy professional HRP server, just a server for people to goof around on, playing a sandbox roleplaying game like a sandbox roleplaying game. Just don't go yelling about how Joshua Pringle stabbed you to death in maintainence, please.
# The Rules Proper
## 1. No bigotry or suggestive content of any kind.
- Believe it or not, people don't like it when you're a raging bigot, or someone who keeps making sex jokes. This is the first rule, because it's the one rule that we won't change our minds on. If you disagree, you're free to look for another server, though I doubt any will be to your liking.
## 2. Try to escelate encounters.
- If you are not an antagonist, anything that may cause harm should at the very least have a good motive. "I don't like them!" is not proper escelation. "They have been annoying me since I first woke up, so I beat them up!" is.
## 3. Play your role.
- Command members should command. Security should keep the station safe. Scientists should do research. You don't have to spend [bold]every second[/bold] of [bold]every round[/bold] doing boring job duties, but should people need to rely on YOU doing YOUR job, you should at the very least be able to step up to bat.
## 4. Don't break shit for the sake of it.
- You are playing a character that a company would willingly hire, through several background checks. You shouldn't be destroying the whole station because you feel like it. Do you have a good reason to do so, something that you can point to [bold]in the round[/bold] that gave your character that reason? Then go ahead.
## 5. If all else fails, AHELP.
- Admin Help is multiple things. It's a place to request things, it's a place to report things, and it's a place for us to reach out to you, should we need some amount of information. Don't be afraid of using it if you need something. We do this for free, for fun, for you, and it's all casual.
